question_intents: How to configure Hector zones in Qursor
data.summary: This section outlines the administrative configuration of Hector zones by Qursor users, detailing the use of the zones configurator for defining parameters and visual polygons. It explains the integration with Navithor maps through zone ID placement and ID mapping via the zones.json file, while highlighting operational limitations and sensitivity regarding map modifications.

own_body.title: 4. Configuration
own_body.summary: Hector zones are configured by Qursor admin users.

children.title: 4.1 . Zones configurator
children.summary: This section details the default settings and versioning capabilities of the zones configurator, including parameters for zone distances, server addresses, and the management of zones.json files. It further specifies the required attributes for defining individual zones, such as name, ID, and type, and describes the use of a visual editor for drawing and modifying zone polygons.

children.title: 4.2. Map preparing
children.summary: The section explains that Qursor zones relate to zoneID points defined in the Navithor map, requiring points to be defined on segments approaching the zone and on the zone border, with references to figures illustrating the zone drawing and zoneID placement.
question_intents: How are Qursor zones defined in the Navithor map?

children.title: 4.3. ID mapping
children.summary: The section describes the mapping of zone IDs created in Qursor Configurator to zoneIDs in the Navithor map via the Qursor Fleet Manager configuration file (zones.json). It details the structure of the zones, locks, and relations sections, explaining how AGV tags lock zones and how logical operations on zoneID points determine zone locking conditions.
question_intents: How are zones mapped between Qursor Configurator and Navithor?

children.title: 4.4. Limitations
children.summary: The section warns that placing zone IDs on the map is sensitive and that modifying the map or changing IDs may disturb the operation of zones in Qursor.
question_intents: What are the limitations regarding zone ID placement?
